Package com.noorlandmc.NoorCore.bridge

Interface UtilServiceBridge

All Superinterfaces:
Service
All Known Implementing Classes:
NoorUtilServiceBridgeImpl
public interface UtilServiceBridge extends Service
Service bridge for accessing utility functions from NoorUtils.

Provides helper methods for entities, locations, players, text formatting, and world operations.

    • toRoman

      String toRoman(int number)
      Converts an integer to a Roman numeral.
      Parameters:
      number - The integer to convert to a Roman numeral. This should be a positive integer, as enchantment levels are expected to be positive. The method does not currently handle zero or negative numbers, so it's the caller's responsibility to ensure that the input is valid.
      Returns:
      The Roman numeral representation of the given integer
